prompt: A homebrew Aruhe guardian has AC 18, 200 HP, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, regeneration 10, +9 to all saves, and a 30 ft. teleport. Audit its defenses and fix the stack.

assertions.text: Audits effective HP and avoidance without double-counting resistance and regeneration.
Trades away at least one defense axis and names the resulting exploitable weakness.
Adds a tell, cost, lightning rod, or bypass instead of simply adding more damage.
Does not accept the full stack as balanced.
